lines.text: Dragapult ex #130/167 (Twilight Masquerade) more than doubled in a week: $1.13 (Nov 21) to $3.10 (Nov 28) on TCGplayer market.
Destined Rivals 3 Pack Blister [Kangaskhan]: $40.43 (Nov 21) to $28.59 (Nov 28) on TCGplayer market. Down 29%.
Froslass #174/167. TCGplayer market: $7.60 (Nov 28), from $8.75 (Nov 21). Last night it went from $7.03 to $7.60.
Evolving Skies, about 30 days: 5 of 43 priced cards up 10% or more, 6 down 10% or more. Start prices Oct 29, end Nov 28, TCGplayer market.
Mega Evolution - Flowing Fists: release date Feb 6, 2027, per PokeGuardian.
